title: HS69013: Business Communication
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Course Content
Communication in business: communication and organizational effectiveness;
formal and informal communication systems; communication networks and
communication technology; Written: Effective business writing (style, wordusage, organization, mechanics, and forms) for specific purposes; business
report writing, meeting, agendas and minutes; employment-process communication
(cover letter, resume, follow up writing); Oral: Speaking and listening skills;
conversation skills, interview and group discussion skills; public presentation
(research, organization and delivery); business etiquette and protocol;
Nonverbal and technical: voice and delivery, body language basics, emails and
web pages.
